notes: Paper derives new bounds on axion-photon coupling from non-observation of an axion-sourced fireball from GW170817/GRB 170817A using X-ray flux upper limits (90% C.L.) from CALET CGBM, Konus-Wind, and Insight-HXMT/HE. This is an astrophysical (NS merger) bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density assumption. The exclusion region (Fig. 3, red) spans axion masses ~1-400 MeV with couplings excluded down to ~5e-11 GeV^-1 at the floor. Precise contour is only shown graphically; only the stated floor value and mass validity range from the abstract are encoded here as a two-point line, so the actual exclusion boundary shape (which weakens toward both mass edges and closes near 400 MeV) is not captured. Full digitization of Fig. 3 would be needed for the exact contour. An illustrative point ma=202 MeV, g=2.2e-10 GeV^-1 lies inside the excluded region. | selector: text (sole candidate)
